notes.title: Vorax at Gamescom with Open Alpha Ready to Play
notes.content:
[h1]HUGE Progress Update on our newest game[/h1]
[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/e720f54b3a2868a7d11c877b3123dd2b65ef0c84.jpg[/img][/url]
We know we usually don't post about this that often, sorry for the long post, but this is a special occasion that we wanted to share with all the community, thank you for your patience. More surprises are coming soon. You can try the updated [url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha]Open Alpha[/url] or Demo for [b]FREE[/b] today.

In just a few days we will be present at Gamescom 2023, in Germany. You will be able to find us in hall 10.1 booth B-093 and hall 02.1 stand A-0007.

But for those at home, who can't make it, we also have [b]something [b]HUGE[/b] for you.[/b] Gain access to a 10 times bigger map (10 square kilometers), vehicles, new weapons and zones. Find out more.

[previewyoutube=AwZUSuHQsYs;full][/previewyoutube]

An updated Steam demo and an updated full build. Also [b]exclusive open alpha opportunity[/b] for the most loyal fans. 

We are talking about new weapons, an expanded map, new enemies and a whole lot more.

[h2]Updated Steam Demo & Open Alpha[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

If you do not own it yet on Steam, it's fine. You can play the Updated Demo on Steam right now. It's [b]free[/b], it has most of the new elements added to it, you can get a taste of what's to come at Gamescom. Even if on a smaller map (only 1km2), the horror and survival will be the same, just in a smaller dose. 

[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/5bd4cd61393d3c1040ab090db02f2e64ffe8d4fd.jpg[/img][/url]

If you are interested to spice the experience, you can try the [url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][b]Open Alpha[/b] on our website[/url]. Which, it brings all of the above mentioned plus two exclusive weapons: SAP-6 and the AK-47. With these bad boys at your side your survival chances will exponentially grow...if you find the ammo for them. Find them somewhere well hidden on the map.

[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/8a01ee88bc3cad223cb590cf9685853ae1c01d55.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Something [b]HUGE[/b] for those who got Full Game Early[/h2]

Not only you will get access to everything mentioned earlier, but also the possibility to explore the full map. Nearly 10 times bigger [u](10 square kilometers)[/u], with vehicles, new weapons, new enemies and a lot more. Your experience will be close to similar to those from Gamescom.

[url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/db9fab173a6ab7412c069efa1d9702ffa85a90e9.jpg[/img][/url]

If you haven't bought it already, you can get it directly, early and cheaper from [url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/]our website[/url] and support our development progress. If you did, you can already head to your profile library and download the new updated build right now. Keep in mind it does get updated regularly, so you can check back again later for something new.

[url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/9011f1e1c6c6347a0d12bdb49ecd11648e605e51.jpg[/img][/url]

And yes, of course, you will also get a Steam Key as soon as it releases on Steam, you will not be forgotten. But in the meantime, make sure you wishlist it, if you haven't already. And if you will be in Cologne next week, see you there, let's meet.

[previewyoutube=qES69bfFKAk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Wishlist now:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/
[url=https://discord.gg/bXnMMb3Yrc][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/5bb2433aad01fce79766323ac1cd5fb9c55d7a59.png[/img][/url]
